title: Stock markets take winning run to third day; Sensex climbs 262 points
description: From the Sensex pack, HCL Tech surged 5.79%, followed by Tech Mahindra which climbed 1.81%. Bharti Airtel, Sun Pharma, Bajaj Finserv, UltraTech Cement, Tata Steel Bajaj Finance, Tata Consultancy Services, and ICICI Bank were also among the winners.
